name: NYU Stern LARA
outcome: 2 core experiences connecting the organization’s story with its programming.

caseStudy.problem: A student organization needs a clear place to introduce itself and make its programming discoverable to prospective members and partners.
caseStudy.whatWeBuilt: An organization website with a dedicated programming showcase, clear navigation, and layouts for desktop and mobile.
caseStudy.results: 2 core experiences—organization overview and programming showcase—give visitors a direct path from discovering LARA to exploring its activities. Both are documented at desktop and mobile sizes. Membership and event-attendance data have not been supplied.
